scope: Outcome-blind Sentinel-2 L1C target availability audit for the independent Evanston, Wyoming controlled-release site.

site.name: Rawhide Leasing Yard, Evanston, Wyoming
site.geocoder: Esri World Geocoder legacy public endpoint

source.site_evidence: The thesis describes 81 releases at Rawhide Leasing Yard between August 1 and October 16, 2024.
source.inventory_evidence: The SDR filename inventory contains nine Evanston-period S2A/S2B event directories before the Casa Grande campaign.

catalog_contract.platform_match: item ID prefix must equal frozen S2A/S2B platform
catalog_contract.official_validation: Validate productName and MGRS against public official tileInfo.json.
catalog_contract.selection: minimum catalog cloud cover, then item ID, among exact date/platform products covering the point

forbidden: Do not open Evanston release-data CSVs, summary CSVs, flow rates, labels, team detections, or detector outputs during target audit.
Do not use Landsat L2 or Sentinel-2 L2A.
Do not select events based on release magnitude or outcome.
claim_boundary: Availability audit only. No labels, scores, performance result, or generalization claim.
